description: Ray tests, point analysis, cross-sections, and edge continuity. measurement_type selects the operation: ray, ray_grid, point_analysis, section, or continuity.

analyze.description: Section analysis mode. edge_count = count and describe edges; thickness = measure section thickness.

bidirectional.description: Fire rays in both directions. Used by ray_grid.

checks.description: Checks to perform at each point. Required for point_analysis.

detail.description: stats = min/max/avg; samples = hit coordinates; hits = full grid results.

direction.description: Ray direction [x,y,z]. Used by ray, ray_grid.

direction_mode.description: Direction shortcut. axis = along entity axis; normal = along entity normal.

entity_ids.description: Entity IDs from find_faces/find_edges or inspect_step bodies.

file_path.description: Path to STEP file on local filesystem.

max_distance.description: Maximum ray distance mm. If set, ray becomes bounded (ray_test_segment).

measurement_type.description: ray = single ray from origin in direction; ray_grid = grid of rays across entity; point_analysis = classify/project/curvature at points; section = planar cross-section; continuity = edge smoothness between adjacent faces.

origin.description: Ray origin [x,y,z]. Used by ray. Mutually exclusive with origin_mode.

origin_mode.description: Origin shortcut relative to entity bounding box. Used by ray.

plane_normal.description: Normal of cutting plane. Required for section.

plane_origin.description: Point on cutting plane. Required for section.

points.description: 3D points to analyze. Required for point_analysis.

spacing_mm.description: Grid spacing mm. Used by ray_grid. Default 2.

tolerance.description: Tolerance mm for point checks. Default 0.01.

name: measure_geometry
